title: CrmConvertContactInput
description: Read from the merged `{ ...ctx.config, ...ctx.inputs }` bag (inputs win) — chain-authored config and DAG-forwarded inputs are both legal sources, so nothing is `required` here; the SURFACE refuses a missing key with a typed `validation_error` (a node failure, never success-with-empty).

contactId.description: The lead to convert. Falls back to `entityId`.

orgId.description: The org the company + deal are created in.

companyName.description: Company name; defaults to the contact's `company`.

pipelineId.description: Target pipeline; defaults to the org's default pipeline.

dealTitle.description: Deal title; defaults to a derived title.
